requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Enhanced Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed bottles supporting 6,000 pages for Black and 6,000 pages for CMY, with bottle size for CMY supporting over 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Increases ink capacity and reduces frequency of bottle replacement, improving customer satisfaction and lowering operational costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with existing and new printer hardware, bottle keying mechanism, and IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must fit in the designated slots, deliver the specified page yields, and pass reliability testing for spill-free operation.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure all new ink bottles and filling processes are spill-free, including reliability validation for NOA-F with metal foiled labyrinth and lid label.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents ink spillage, reduces mess for users, and enhances product reputation for quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle and tank design, manufacturing process controls.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spillage during standard and stress use-case scenarios, validated in lab and field tests.

requirements.Title: NOA-F Service Parts Availability
requirements.Description: NOA-F (with metal foiled labyrinth and lid label) must be available as a service part for warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures serviceability and customer support continuity during warranty period.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design finalization, supply chain setup.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F parts can be ordered and replaced during warranty service events.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 Integration on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology on the ink bottle lid for improved product tracking and authentication.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances anti-counterfeiting and supply chain traceability.
requirements.Dependencies: Lid design, Acumen 6 tech integration, software support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All bottles shipped have Acumen 6 enabled lids and can be authenticated via HP systems.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modification for NOA-F and Magi Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify SA14 factory line to accommodate NOA-F, add Magi ink cartridge and labeling tool in Orcus 5, and create molds for 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: Supports production scalability and introduction of new bottle and cap designs.
requirements.Dependencies: Design freeze for NOA-F, Magi ink cart, and cap keying.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines operational with new modifications, producing conforming products.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Enable customers to replace PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F components to enhance serviceability and reduce downtime.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience by reducing service turnaround time and cost.
requirements.Dependencies: Design for user-accessible components, documentation, and training.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can replace PHA and NOA-F following provided instructions without specialized tools.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Set a new warranty page life goal for the product at 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Extends product value and competitiveness in the market.
requirements.Dependencies: Component durability, consumable capacity, reliability engineering.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product operates within specifications for at least 80,000 pages under normal usage.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Implement Reddington ID with an increased tank size to accommodate higher ink capacity, with no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher page yields and aligns with new bottle capacities.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank design, industrial design integration, ADF compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer tank accommodates new bottle sizes and maintains industrial design standards.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the PDL SKU meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental certification requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Meets regulatory and market-driven eco-labeling demands, enhancing product appeal in key markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Product design, materials selection, documentation for certification.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is certified and listed under EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel before launch.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign input and output trays to align with the protrusion caused by the enlarged ink tank.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains usability and ensures smooth paper handling despite tank size changes.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank size finalization, mechanical design updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function correctly with new tank configuration and pass paper handling tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch Color Graphic Display (CGD) into the printer interface.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user interaction and accessibility, aligning with modern UI expectations.
requirements.Dependencies: Display hardware sourcing, firmware support, mechanical design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All units ship with fully functional 4.3” CGD, validated in usability tests.

requirements.Title: New Tube Routing and Integration
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes and introduce new tube routing and integration for the ink delivery system.
requirements.Rationale: Optimizes ink flow, reliability, and supports new tank/bottle formats.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube design, platform integration, reliability validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink flows reliably through new routing with no leaks or clogs under all operating conditions.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management Enhancement
requirements.Description: Modify service station aerosol management and spit platform to accommodate changes due to new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents ink mist and aerosol from affecting printer internals, maintaining print quality and reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank design, service station redesign.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No measurable increase in aerosol contamination in internal tests compared to previous models.

requirements.Title: Paperpath Durability for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Upgrade paperpath components to support increased product page life (80K pages).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent performance and reduces maintenance over the product’s extended life.
requirements.Dependencies: Component selection, durability testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paperpath operates within specifications for 80,000 pages with minimal maintenance.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as a Serviceable Part Post-80K Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance components to be serviceable at service centers after the product reaches 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Extends product lifecycle and supports post-warranty service models.
requirements.Dependencies: Component modularity, service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace maintenance parts post-80K life with standard tools and procedures.

requirements.Title: New IDS Make-Break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new IDS (Ink Delivery System) make-break and FI (Filling Interface) connection, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Supports larger ink tanks and prevents incorrect bottle installation.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS and FI design, tank keying, SHAID integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS/FI connections are reliable, prevent misinstallation, and pass all functional tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new IDS startup algorithm and air management approach to optimize system priming and minimize startup issues.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and print quality from first use, reducing startup failures.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS hardware, firmware development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm reliably primes system and manages air, validated in lab and field tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion to Meet Page Yield Definition
requirements.Description: Define and implement new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion management to align with updated page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures print quality is maintained throughout the product life and at specified yields.
requirements.Dependencies: PQ metric definition, firmware updates, consumable monitoring.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality remains within defined limits for the stated yield; depletion is accurately reported.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, and Stingray Wi-Fi Module
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, and Stingray Wi-Fi module for the new product.
requirements.Rationale: Leverages proven hardware, reduces development time and cost.
requirements.Dependencies: Component compatibility, firmware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components function as specified in the new product context.

requirements.Title: Security Enhancements with Gauss4.xx (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Integrate Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Improves product security and compliance with modern IT requirements.
requirements.Stakeholders: IT Security, Product Management, Enterprise Customers
requirements.Dependencies: Gauss4.xx integration, hardware/firmware updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes all internal and external security audits with Gauss4.xx features enabled.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS Business Model and SMB/Enterprise Solutions
requirements.Description: Enable support for Printer-as-a-Service (PaaS) business model, including SMB manageability, onboarding paths, and enterprise solutions (WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and meets evolving customer needs for managed print solutions.
requirements.Stakeholders: Business Development, Enterprise Customers, SMB, Service
requirements.Dependencies: Solution software, onboarding workflow, integration with HP platforms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product supports all listed business models and solutions, validated in pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: High Throughput: 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Achieve print speeds of 25ppm (pages per minute) for standard, and 25/19ppm for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Meets competitive benchmarks and customer expectations for performance.
requirements.Dependencies: Engine tuning, firmware optimization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printers achieve specified speeds in standardized benchmark tests.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp Printhead Assembly (PHA) achieves a life of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with constrained business priority for durability and service cost reduction.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA design, materials selection, reliability validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA prints at least 65,000 pages without failure in reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty life of 2 years for the product.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market and customer expectations for reliability and support.
requirements.Dependencies: Product reliability, component durability, service infrastructure.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is covered under warranty for 2 years from purchase date, with full support provided.

requirements.Title: Serviceability - Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Include a maintenance box that is easily serviceable by users or service technicians.
requirements.Rationale: Improves ease of maintenance and reduces service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box design, documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced or serviced with minimal effort and standard tools.
